parameters.query:
SELECT * 
FROM chapters
WHERE manuscript_id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.manuscriptId }}'
ORDER BY chapter_number ASC

SELECT 
  m.id as manuscript_id,
  m.manuscript_summary,
  m.full_analysis_key_points,
  m.title as manuscript_title
FROM manuscripts m
WHERE m.id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.manuscriptId }}'

UPDATE manuscripts 
SET 
  full_analysis_completed_at = NOW(),
  status = 'editing'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.manuscriptId }}'
RETURNING id, title, status, full_analysis_completed_at;

parameters.query: UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'received', received_at = NOW() WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'ready', completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'failed', completed_at = NOW(), terminal_reason = $2 WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
